instruction: Candid studio portrait, medium full shot. In a minimalist indoor studio with a light beige wall, three women pose together. On the right, the woman with curly dark hair (R1) in a white shirt sits upright, looking forward. On the left, the woman with straight dark hair (R2) in a denim jacket leans her head on R1's shoulder. In the foreground, the woman with curly brown hair (R3) in a black crop top lies with her head on R1's lap, looking up. Soft, diffused lighting creates a warm, gentle atmosphere.
